# Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that runs the tasks the server gives a running active proxy session.

## SYNTAX

```
Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler [-Name] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler cmdlet sets the task handler of the active proxy session named in -Name: the server hands a proxy tasks, such as a remote command, in the answer to an upload, and the session runs the scriptblock for each, on its own runspace, with the task as its argument. The scriptblock's last output is reported back as the task's result; a scriptblock that throws reports a failure with the exception's message. It writes the session only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Answer remote commands

```powershell
Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler -Name 'uplink' -ScriptBlock {
    param($task)
    "received task $($task.TaskId)"
}
```

The task carries the command; the handler's output is what the server shows as the result.

### Example 2: Refuse every task

```powershell
Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler -Name 'uplink' -ScriptBlock { throw 'remote commands are disabled on this proxy' } -PassThru |
    Select-Object Name
```

Throwing reports the task as failed, with the message as its reason; -PassThru writes the session.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixActiveProxySession`: Represents an active proxy's uplink kept running as a session: it re-pulls the configuration on -RefreshInterval, over a ZabbixProxyUplink built with no DI container — the SDK type composes over a plain .
